heroSub: Twelve Nakhon Si Thammarat stays across every budget — beachfront resorts in Khanom down to a temple-side stay near Wat Chedi Ai Khai from ฿600. Covering the destinations travellers actually use: Khanom, the city, Sichon and Kiriwong. Starting from around ฿600–4,500/night.
introH2: 🛕 Why does choosing the right base in Nakhon Si Thammarat matter so much?
introHtml: Nakhon Si Thammarat is a big province where the sights are spread far apart, so matching your stay to what you actually want to do matters more than the hotel itself. Khanom is the Gulf coast — quiet beaches and pink-dolphin spotting, with a handful of beachfront resorts · Nakhon Si Thammarat city (Mueang Khon) is the hub for Wat Phra Mahathat, southern food and well-priced town hotels · Sichon is home to Wat Chedi Ai Khai, the temple people flock to for blessings all year · and Kiriwong is a foothill village on Khao Luang with cool air and mountain views. Many travellers book without realising their hotel is in a different district, then spend an hour each way driving to reach where they want to go. This guide brings together 12 Nakhon Si Thammarat stays we've reviewed across every tier — every pick comes from reading real guest reviews, with prices compared across 3 sites and direct booking links throughout.
mrtHtml: Nakhon Si Thammarat has no metro — getting around is mainly by car. There's an airport (NST) with direct flights from Bangkok, about 20–30 minutes into the city. From the city it's roughly 1.5–2 hours to Khanom, about 1 hour to Sichon, and around 40 minutes up to Kiriwong — renting a car or having your own ride is by far the easiest. The main destinations in this guide: Khanom (Gulf coast, Nai Phlao-Nadan beaches) — Aava Resort, Racha Kiri, Khanom Beach Resort, Khanom Golden Beach · Mueang Khon (near Wat Phra Mahathat) — The Twin Lotus, B2 Premier, @24, iBiz · Sichon (Wat Chedi Ai Khai) — Sky Home, Cedi Resort · Kiriwong-Lan Saka (Khao Luang foothills) — Passion Resort Kiriwong · and Phra Phrom on the city outskirts — The Peak Boutique Hotel.

entries.name: Aava Resort & Spa
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Nai Phlao-Nadan beach · Khanom · on the Gulf
entries.addr: 28 Moo 3, Nadan Beach Road, Nai Phlao, Khanom, Nakhon Si Thammarat
entries.storyHtml: Aava Resort & Spa is the most upscale beachfront resort in this guide, on Khanom's Nai Phlao-Nadan beach, scoring 8.9. Real guest reviews praise the minimalist seafront bungalows that feel quiet and private, a pool facing the sea, and warm staff. The Gulf coast here is calm and lovely for an early-morning beach walk, and you're in the Khanom area where boats head out to spot the pink dolphins — a relaxed beach base for couples who want somewhere unhurried.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Entry-level Superior Bungalows don't all face the sea directly — upgrade to a Pool Side Villa if you want the water close. For dolphin tours, go in the morning when the water is calmer; the resort can help arrange it.
pros: The most upscale beachfront resort here, quiet minimalist feel
Pool faces the sea; private beach for walks
Warm service and an on-site spa
In the Khanom area — easy access to pink-dolphin boat tours
cons: Highest price in this guide — a beach-getaway pick
Some entry rooms don't face the sea directly · far from the city

entries.name: The Twin Lotus Hotel
entries.revCount: 173 reviews · highest score in this guide
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Pattanakan-Kukwang Rd · Mueang Khon · tallest in town
tags: 🏙️ High floors with wide city views
entries.addr: 97/8 Pattanakan-Kukwang Rd, Nai Mueang, Mueang, Nakhon Si Thammarat
entries.storyHtml: The Twin Lotus is the highest-scoring city hotel in this guide — 9.2 from 173 reviews, from just ฿800. Real guest reviews note it's the tallest building in the city, so upper floors get wide views, the rooms are spacious and clean, and there's a pool and gym that are hard to find at this price. The in-city location puts Wat Phra Mahathat and the southern-food streets a 5–10 minute drive away — a comfortable, well-equipped base on a friendly budget.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a high floor for the views and the quiet. The building is older but well kept — pick a refurbished Superior/Deluxe over a Standard for the better condition.
pros: Highest score here — 9.2 from 173 reviews, from ฿800
Tallest building in town; wide city views from upper floors
Has a pool and gym — rare at this price
In-city location, easy drive to the temple and food streets
cons: Older building; some Standard rooms lag the refurbished ones
A city hotel — not a beach or nature stay

entries.name: B2 Nakhon Si Thammarat Premier Hotel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Si Prat Rd · Tha Wang area · Mueang Khon
entries.addr: 1584/23 Si Prat Rd, Tha Wang, Mueang, Nakhon Si Thammarat
entries.storyHtml: B2 Premier is the most-reviewed stay in this guide — over 1,054 reviews, still scoring 8.8, which speaks to consistency from just ฿650. Real guest reviews praise the fresh, clean earth-tone rooms, comfortable beds, and a central Tha Wang location with food within walking distance. The Luxury Triple sleeps three at no extra charge, making it a good-value pick for small groups and families in the city.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Travelling as three? The Luxury Triple beats booking two rooms. The Tha Wang area is lively at night — ask for an inner room away from the street for more quiet.
pros: Most-reviewed here — 1,054 reviews, a steady 8.8
Fresh, clean earth-tone rooms; comfortable beds
Central Tha Wang location, food within walking distance
Triple rooms sleep 3 at no extra charge · free parking
cons: A chain room-only hotel — no swimming pool
Lively area at night; street-facing rooms can be noisy

entries.name: Racha Kiri Resort & Spa
entries.revCount: 51 reviews · every room a sea view · Khanom
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Nai Phlao beach · Khanom · on the Gulf
entries.addr: 99 Moo 8, Nai Phlao Beach, Nai Phlao-Thong Nian Rd, Khanom, Nakhon Si Thammarat
entries.storyHtml: Racha Kiri is a Khanom beachfront resort whose hook is that every room is a sea-view room, scoring 8.7 from 51 reviews and starting at ฿2,300. Real guest reviews praise the Gulf views from the balconies and the quiet atmosphere, with a seafront pool and villa rooms that have a bay-view tub. Its Nai Phlao location makes for a beach getaway that's more affordable than many upscale resorts — good value for couples and families who want a sea view.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a balcony where you can sit and take in the full sea view, the Superior Sea View With Balcony is worth the small step up. Travelling as a family? The 76 sqm Family Suite is more comfortable.
pros: Every room is a sea-view room over the Gulf
From ฿2,300 — good value for a sea-view beach resort
Seafront pool · villas with a bay-view tub
Quiet atmosphere; Family Suite for groups
cons: The beach out front shows more mudflat than white sand at low tide
In the Khanom area — far from the city and airport

entries.name: Sky Home Wat Chedi Ai Khai Resort & Restaurant
entries.revCount: 83 reviews · highest score in the province · near Wat Ai Khai
entries.badge: 🙏 Near Wat Chedi Ai Khai, best value
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Sao Phao · Sichon · near Wat Chedi Ai Khai
entries.addr: 57 Moo 9, Sao Phao, Sichon (near Wat Chedi Ai Khai), Nakhon Si Thammarat
entries.storyHtml: Sky Home is the highest-scoring stay in the province — 9.4 from 83 reviews, from just ฿600 — and it sits near Wat Chedi Ai Khai, the temple people flock to for blessings. Real guest reviews say the rooms are cleaner than the price suggests, the owner is friendly and hands-on, and the on-site restaurant means you don't have to drive out to eat. The family rooms sleep anywhere from 4 to 8, ideal for a group driving in to pay respects at Wat Ai Khai who want to stay nearby on a budget.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: In a group? The Family Room or Deluxe Family Suite sleeps up to 8 and works out very cheap split between you. On long weekends the temple draws crowds and rooms fill fast — book ahead.
pros: Highest score in the province — 9.4 from 83 reviews, from ฿600
Near Wat Chedi Ai Khai, easy drive to the temple
Family rooms sleep 4–8 — very cheap split between you
On-site restaurant; friendly hands-on owner
cons: Simple bungalows — not a resort with a pool
In Sichon, far from the city and the main beaches

entries.name: Khanom Beach Resort & Spa
entries.revCount: 45 reviews · on Nadan beach · has pool villas
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Nadan beach · Khanom · on the sea
entries.addr: 3/9 Moo 6, Nadan Beach, Khanom, Nakhon Si Thammarat
entries.storyHtml: Khanom Beach Resort is a Nadan-beach resort with rooms more spacious than most in the area, scoring 8.5 from 45 reviews. Real guest reviews praise the rooms of 46 sqm and up, the large separate bathrooms, and the on-the-beach location where you can walk straight down to the water. It runs from Deluxe rooms up to a Private Pool Villa, making it a roomy beachfront choice for couples and families in Khanom.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The entry-level Deluxe Garden View faces the garden — upgrade to a Deluxe Sea View for the water. For a group or extra privacy, the Private Pool Villa has its own pool.
pros: Right on Nadan beach — walk straight to the water
Spacious rooms 46 sqm and up; large separate bathrooms
Ranges from Deluxe up to a Private Pool Villa
Has a seafront spa — relaxing for couples and families
cons: Entry Garden View rooms don't see the sea — upgrade to Sea View
Starting price is higher than other Khanom resorts of similar level

entries.name: @24 Boutique Hotel
entries.addr: 19/25 Soi 24/1, Pattanakan-Kukwang Rd, Nai Mueang, Mueang, Nakhon Si Thammarat
entries.storyHtml: @24 Boutique is a city boutique hotel with bright, cheerful decor from ฿650, scoring 8.8 from 39 reviews. Real guest reviews praise the clean, characterful rooms and the Pattanakan-Kukwang location with an easy drive to Wat Phra Mahathat and the city's restaurants. There are non-smoking rooms to choose from, and the Deluxe (one King + two Queen beds) sleeps several — a likeable, budget-friendly pick for couples and small groups.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: In a group? The Deluxe Room has plenty of beds and works out better value. Want a non-smoking room? Request it at booking — there are only a limited number.
pros: Bright, cheerful decor; clean rooms from ฿650
In-city, easy drive to the temple and restaurants
Non-smoking rooms available
Deluxe room has lots of beds, sleeps several
cons: Fewer reviews (39) than the big city hotels
A small hotel — no pool or gym

entries.name: iBiz Boutique Hotel
entries.addr: 243/83 Pattanakan-Kukwang Rd, Nai Mueang, Mueang, Nakhon Si Thammarat
entries.storyHtml: iBiz Boutique is a city boutique hotel whose standout is the soundproof glass in the rooms for a better sleep, scoring 8.4 from 115 reviews and starting at ฿950. Real guest reviews praise the roomy ~32 sqm rooms, the quiet thanks to that soundproofing, and the Pattanakan-Kukwang location with food nearby and an easy drive to the city sights. There's a Family Room for small families too — a comfortable, quiet base for business travellers and tourists in the city.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Staying a while on business? The Superior Room is roomier. For a small family, the Family Room is more comfortable than the Deluxe.
pros: Soundproof glass in rooms makes for a quiet sleep
Roomy ~32 sqm rooms at this price level
In-city — food nearby, easy drive to the sights
Family Room for small families · free parking
cons: 8.4 is slightly below the top city hotels here
A boutique hotel — no pool or gym

entries.name: Khanom Golden Beach Hotel
entries.revCount: 47 reviews · sea-view rooms · Nai Phlao beach
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Nai Phlao (Nai Dan) beach · Khanom · on the sea
tags: 🛁 Some Deluxe rooms have a tub
entries.addr: 59/3 Moo 4, Nai Phlao (Nai Dan) Beach, Khanom, Nakhon Si Thammarat
entries.storyHtml: Khanom Golden Beach is a Nai Phlao beachfront hotel with sea-view balcony rooms from ฿1,200, scoring 8.6 from 47 reviews. Real guest reviews praise the wide Gulf views from the balconies, the on-the-beach location for seaside strolls, and a price that's more reachable than the upscale resorts in the same area. Upper-floor Deluxe rooms have wider sea views and some have a tub — a good fit if you want a Khanom beach stay without paying resort prices.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For the widest sea view, choose a high-floor Deluxe. It's a hotel rather than a resort with a pool — if you're set on a pool, another pick on this list will suit better.
pros: Sea-view balconies with wide Gulf views
Right on Nai Phlao beach for seaside walks
From ฿1,200 — more reachable than upscale resorts nearby
High-floor Deluxe rooms have wide views; some have a tub
cons: A beachfront hotel — no swimming pool like a resort
Plain, simple building and rooms — not a new design

entries.name: The Peak Boutique Hotel
entries.revCount: 459 reviews · Phra Phrom outskirts · easy to book
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Na San · Phra Phrom district · city outskirts
entries.addr: 9 Moo 7, Na San, Phra Phrom, Nakhon Si Thammarat
entries.storyHtml: The Peak Boutique is a budget stay on the city outskirts with as many as 459 reviews — the most in the budget group, scoring 8.2 from ฿650. Real guest reviews praise the clean, quiet rooms (breakfast included in some), the garden and pool views, and the spacious free parking that makes driving in and out easy. It's out in Phra Phrom district, so it suits drivers passing through or stopping over, and budget travellers who want a comfortable, quiet room.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The Superior King with breakfast is only about ฿100 more and worth it. Being on the outskirts, having your own car beats waiting for a ride into the city.
pros: Most reviews in the budget group — 459, scoring 8.2
From ฿650; breakfast included in some rooms
Clean, quiet rooms with garden/pool views
Spacious free parking, easy to drive in and out
cons: On the Phra Phrom outskirts, far from the city centre

entries.name: Passion Resort Kiriwong
entries.revCount: 14 reviews · Khao Luang foothills, Kiriwong · cool air
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Kiriwong village · Lan Saka · Khao Luang foothills
entries.addr: 199 Moo 4, Kiriwong Village, Kamlon, Lan Saka, Nakhon Si Thammarat
entries.storyHtml: Passion Resort Kiriwong is a small boutique resort in Kiriwong village selling mountain views and the cool foothill air of Khao Luang, scoring 7.9 from 14 reviews and starting at ฿1,500. Real guest reviews praise the panoramic mountain view from the Suite, the quiet, restful atmosphere, and the spot near Kiriwong village known for its nature and streamside cafes — a fit for couples and anyone wanting to escape the heat for cooler mountain air you won't find in the city.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For the full mountain view, choose a front-facing Suite Mountain View. The road up to Kiriwong is narrow and winding — drive in daylight, and pack a light jacket as it can get cool.
pros: Panoramic mountain-view Suite; quiet, restful feel
Cool Khao Luang foothill air — an escape from the heat
Near Kiriwong village, its nature and streamside cafes
Suits couples and nature lovers wanting to unwind
cons: Few reviews so far (14) — limited guest feedback
Narrow winding road up — best with your own car, in daylight

entries.name: Cedi Resort
entries.revCount: Next to Wat Chedi Ai Khai · Sichon · walk to the temple
entries.badge: 🙏 Next to Wat Chedi Ai Khai
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Chalong · Sichon · next to Wat Chedi Ai Khai

entries.addr: 27 Chalong (next to Wat Chedi Ai Khai), Sichon, Nakhon Si Thammarat
entries.storyHtml: Cedi Resort is a small resort right next to Wat Chedi Ai Khai — you can walk to the temple — from ฿750. It's a newer stay with few reviews so far (3), but the appeal is clear: a temple-side location for anyone coming to pay respects to Ai Khai who doesn't want a long drive. It has a Deluxe room with a garden-view balcony, the quietest in the resort, and a Standard King that sleeps up to 4 — handy for groups and families staying close to the temple.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Visiting Wat Ai Khai? Go early to beat the crowds — staying here, it's an easy walk. With so few reviews, check the latest price and room condition before booking.

From ฿750 — handy for an overnight near the temple
Deluxe room with a quiet garden-view balcony
Standard King sleeps up to 4 — good for groups and families

faqTitle: FAQ — Common traveller questions about staying in Nakhon Si Thammarat

faq.q: ❓ Where should tourists stay in Nakhon Si Thammarat?
faq.a: It depends on your destination. Khanom suits a beach stay and pink-dolphin spotting (Aava, Racha Kiri, Khanom Beach Resort, Khanom Golden Beach) · Mueang Khon (the city) suits visiting Wat Phra Mahathat and eating southern food (The Twin Lotus, B2 Premier, @24, iBiz) · Sichon suits a visit to Wat Chedi Ai Khai (Sky Home, Cedi Resort) · Kiriwong suits nature lovers wanting cool mountain air (Passion Resort Kiriwong).

faq.q: ❓ How much do Nakhon Si Thammarat hotels cost?
faq.a: Prices vary widely: budget stays and temple-side bungalows start around ฿600–1,000 a night · city hotels and boutiques run ฿650–1,400 · Khanom beachfront hotels and resorts run about ฿1,200–4,500 · over long weekends, festivals, and busy Wat Ai Khai days, prices can run higher than usual and rooms fill fast.

faq.q: ❓ Where should I stay to visit Wat Chedi Ai Khai?
faq.a: Wat Chedi Ai Khai is in Sichon district, about an hour from the city. If you're coming mainly for the temple and don't want a long drive, stay nearby at Sky Home Wat Chedi Ai Khai (scoring 9.4, from ฿600) or Cedi Resort, which is right next to the temple — you can walk over. Going in the morning means smaller crowds and cooler weather.

faq.q: ❓ Where should I stay to see the pink dolphins in Khanom?
faq.a: Khanom is on the Gulf coast, about 1.5–2 hours from the city, and it's the launch point for pink-dolphin boat tours. There are beachfront stays at every level, from the more upscale Aava Resort and Racha Kiri down to the more affordable Khanom Golden Beach. Take the dolphin tour in the morning when the water is calmer and you're more likely to spot them.

faq.q: ❓ How far in advance should I book a Nakhon Si Thammarat hotel?
faq.a: For ordinary weekdays, 1–2 weeks ahead is enough. But over long weekends, Songkran, New Year, and busy Wat Ai Khai days, the stays near the temple and the Khanom beachfront resorts fill fast — book 3–4 weeks ahead or more.

faq.q: ❓ Which site is cheapest for booking a Nakhon Si Thammarat hotel?
faq.a: Prices on each site (Agoda, Booking.com, Trip.com) differ by promotion at any given time, so it's worth comparing all 3 before you book — each review page in this guide has price-comparison links, which can save you several hundred baht a night.
